recipes.title: Cinematic opening
recipes.prompt: Compose a full-height photographic opening with oversized, short typography, a restrained location badge, one clear inquiry action, and a still, readable mobile layout.

recipes.title: Editorial contrast
recipes.prompt: Use expressive serif headlines against quiet interface typography, generous white space and a split photographic composition. Preserve clear contact paths.

recipes.title: Modern precision
recipes.prompt: Use geometric typography, a disciplined grid and compact sections to make technical services feel precise and approachable.

recipes.title: Tactile service gallery
recipes.prompt: Build eight consistent image-led service cards with framed edges, purposeful crops, short descriptions and service-specific inquiry links.

recipes.title: Soft architectural cards
recipes.prompt: Pair rounded photographic cards with restrained shadows and generous spacing. Never use generic images unrelated to the service.

recipes.title: Interactive cutaway
recipes.prompt: Place a high-quality conceptual system cutaway under accessible SVG highlights and numbered controls. Selecting a component highlights its location and explanation. Keep the base image still and preserve its aspect ratio.

recipes.title: Scroll chapters
recipes.prompt: Reveal sections gently as they enter view without hijacking scrolling. Retain all content when motion is reduced or JavaScript is unavailable.

recipes.title: Image drift
recipes.prompt: Apply subtle desktop image movement while preserving the visual focal point. Disable drift for reduced motion and small displays.

recipes.title: Local motion ribbon
recipes.prompt: Use the supplied service area in a slow repeat ribbon with a visible pause control. Do not invent cities or imply work completed there.

recipes.title: Choose your service
recipes.prompt: Turn service selection into a useful interaction: update the selected state and prepare the inquiry service. Keep all services discoverable.

recipes.title: Process storytelling
recipes.prompt: Make the work process scannable with numbered expandable chapters and short explanations. Keyboard and touch must work naturally.

recipes.title: Conversion without clutter
recipes.prompt: Keep a compact mobile inquiry dock and accessible contact form. Use clear submission states and never simulate successful delivery.

recipes.title: Architectural framing
recipes.prompt: Shape the hero photograph with an arched frame and generous spacing. Keep the subject legible across screen sizes.

recipes.title: Editorial offset
recipes.prompt: Offset the hero image inside a strong grid and use expressive serif typography for a distinctive editorial silhouette.

recipes.title: Mask reveals
recipes.prompt: Use a restrained clipped reveal as sections enter the viewport. Preserve readable content when animation is reduced or unavailable.

recipes.title: Quiet focus
recipes.prompt: Use soft fade and scale entrances to introduce sections without hijacking the scroll.

recipes.title: Progress and chapters
recipes.prompt: Add a slender page-progress line and desktop chapter navigation. Keep content unobstructed and remove links to disabled sections.

recipes.title: Conversation breaks
recipes.prompt: Add short contact invitations at decision points after services and before the form. Every action should reach the same working inquiry destination.

recipes.title: Project discovery
recipes.prompt: Show published projects in a synchronized map and card list with location and service filters. Demo projects must be clearly identified and isolated from actual business claims.

recipes.title: Planning questions
recipes.prompt: Offer a few concise planning questions before the form to help visitors explain their needs. Do not invent business guarantees or operating policies.

recipes.title: Architectural transformation film
recipes.prompt: Create one spatially coherent story: existing space, conceptual AR scan and exposed system, then a finished-space reveal. Keep the building footprint consistent. Use generated motion footage with sound design, a cinematic image poster and chapter controls. Mark it as a visualization, never actual customer work.

recipes.title: Interactive system tour
recipes.prompt: Use a high-quality 3D cutaway base image with precisely positioned SVG highlights, dashed locator guides and a user-controlled scan tour. Numbered controls expose component descriptions. Stop when offscreen and respect reduced motion.
